method: run real resolver.resolve_work on the on-disk corpus; check every emitted relation against the honest-ceiling rules (never MULTI_SOURCE_MATCHED/EDITION_VERIFIED/MULTI_WITNESS/REDISTRIBUTABLE without evidence to license it); gates must not open on RIGHTS=UNKNOWN/DISCOVERABLE.
note: This is the PRODUCER-side rate (what the resolver actually emits). It is distinct from the 0.216 FIXTURE rate in the 51-case natural benchmark, which measures how often a HYPOTHETICAL bad producer is caught (evaluator recall/precision=1.000).
